title: Using Ultromics EchoGo HFpEF Algorithm to Identify and Treat High Heart Failure Risk in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes
official: Identifying Undiagnosed HFpEF Among Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Using Ultromics AI HFpEF Algorithm
summary: A pragmatic electronic health record (EHR) based randomized controlled trial to evaluate the utility of providing Ultromics EchoGo analysis results and recommendations for HF risk prevention therapies using an EHR embedded clinical decision support tool.
criteria:
Clinical cohort inclusion exclusion criteria:

Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes and High WATCH DM score.
* Echocardiogram available in last 6-months.

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of HF
* Not eligible for prescription of new GLP-1RA or SGLT2i or ns-MRA

Corresponding providers to patients identified by the above inclusion exclusion criteria will be included in the clinical trial of the decision support tool.
sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
